summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, declaring monthly distributions for all classes of its common stock at a gross $0.1800 per share, comprising a $0.1600 September distribution plus a $0.0200 special distribution. Net distributions range from $0.1625 to $0.1800, reflecting class-specific stockholder servicing fees. The record date is September 30, 2026, with payment on or about October 15, 2026, in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. As a non-traded REIT, this is effectively a capital return event; watch for net asset value and distribution-coverage trends.
